# Recommended AI consulting firms in Saudi Arabia

For a company looking to develop an AI strategy and implement it—not just produce a strategy deck—I would shortlist a mix of specialist Saudi AI firms and global consulting companies with local delivery capabilities.

The key is to find a partner that can connect AI opportunities to measurable business outcomes, build production-ready solutions, integrate them with existing systems, and establish appropriate data governance under Saudi regulations.

## My recommended shortlist

![Bilytica partner program for channel partners and resellers](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Wrn26y3xuBweZzL9NY9Gy3mqFE1fGv1rNEVwTMNDSNJFIrLI2dzQpr5vV5AyFY73waYHPOFjDEAgTzXZ3p3dWKp_Iw6dqlTBZt6NVbbqWgA3aGOJR_YfusVb1dj5So4RPsidq_0HBzKdFovEEtMUZvqHsTAm1KpQfyOFAIRrc6pYd2aMkHsCFGMSuM_oF8Fz?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Bilytica

(Strong end-to-end option)

Saudi Arabia · [Official website](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/)

Bilytica presents itself as an AI-focused consulting firm covering business strategy, use-case prioritization, AI architecture, implementation, and enterprise transformation. Its published approach also references Saudi requirements such as PDPL and NDMO.

**Best for\:** Organizations seeking one partner to move from AI strategy through implementation and scaling. [bilytica.com](https://bilytica.com/consulting-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Accenture's Manisha Bhattacharya on building careers, changing lives, and empowering the underprivileged  | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Wv8zdx16GU2_6NLbG7a5tDeanor9otRNUwxjiv-ddmuxJ_5QngkQqCPiFjKd89uhvXhnltBU2j4LEyWHTBsokjaGk8auBFmSemNxt7jsGnLfXy4_A700_c--BoFz_6kBMbAoqvorDyqMg98yiz7hTtHGJFfHMBEsBYbh_GE_dTBmgDgyHlh7AUOlWKvPoLDM?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Accenture

Riyadh · [Official website](https://www.accenture.com/sa-en)

A strong candidate for large, complex transformation programs that combine business strategy, data platforms, cloud, AI engineering, systems integration, and organizational change.

**Best for\:** Large enterprises, multi-business groups, and organizations that need AI embedded into core operations at scale. ![About Us | Crux Technology — AI & Data Governance Advisory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_E1IQUzbmsRqDhfV0zOK2sBUmS76VSFLnyDUzVhFYRZ3J5n4hGdMp83aWRx4BaWynXs99aYoUzBCTZpxfDk7gawd2BHOa9BQq8QFdCF8-2xJg4zQvGxi6Hlu_cRLmZgyo-1PAnMgn61CoOESF_CC7PECAoSSqK7K9o18CZI2vR1OIovozvZ_qtDoi9AkscX3?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Crux Technology

Saudi Arabia · [AI strategy services](https://crux.sa/services/ai-strategy-consulting)

Focuses specifically on turning AI strategy into execution, including readiness assessments, high-value use-case selection, investment roadmaps, AI governance, architecture, and production deployment.

**Best for\:** Companies that need a defined AI roadmap with a clear path from initial assessment to working solutions. [crux.sa](https://crux.sa/services/ai-strategy-consulting?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Praca w firmie Capgemini Polska – profil pracodawcy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BIQJrWsljqvE-LY1lBKjg5rvpLrnyWPUl30mTa609eDdumPjYYM1MSYmQqKZAcLXV-c8_aoILIO3o9yGoyGGuhQUhnKf-YrnseZh7_n-KkpCsyx-wIZGN6NM1G8g6H6iyaahwgk81t-t5iaDTZXzWNHRtjaLtU2VGP6eKhqCGd2npHAtQwNKHpg95YU0pQAK?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Capgemini

Riyadh · [Official website](https://www.capgemini.com/)

Combines technology advisory with digital transformation and technology delivery. Worth evaluating for organizations that need AI integrated into enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, data systems, and established business processes.

**Best for\:** Mid-to-large enterprises with complex technology environments. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJAyW2JaADLz4RFzhZfFHVv7Q&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

![agx | NextGen Systems](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aLnHurcRTbypI7Kjvolcwu_fcdKNTTykP7E2iuE4uywgh5eugFgTAewbT-03-AcEBKB9bjaJpoEp2rMeIlj9Rv3iyLn5Bu31BcQsRqRcNTEfSjAMtQBNv5rZvxK58GP8mtj3Jmoueg9q3e2fkUHU0am9EThFLm11_QvjD_GBrrTgGPVwV8h-m0HFm3cyqjo1?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. NextGenSol

Saudi Arabia · [AI consulting services](https://nextgensol.com.sa/ai-consulting/)

Offers a practical combination of AI strategy, readiness assessment, pilot development, implementation, data governance, and training. Its published model emphasizes moving from business opportunities to pilots and wider deployment.

**Best for\:** Companies seeking a potentially more focused engagement, starting with one or two business use cases before scaling. [nextgensol.com.sa](https://nextgensol.com.sa/ai-consulting/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![SCAI - Alef](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p-phrAshk4CHtFS7_kl4lWgyFjYeg6-yX3rDFvkSfWFrHitBKN325D2A5-3nozMBiaXhzYlIYWjbZkyqjBHt91G2HhB2Cc7kD5FB37cOFoGcez5v_3-hBoMVcdG8jPE_-y68n4cUk952hbaF_X4nR2OkLWJxcl-XqC9egqQ46ggUBLXCZcmIlBj32v8TZOtU?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. SCAI

Riyadh · [Company website](https://scai.sa/)

The Saudi Company for Artificial Intelligence is an applied-AI organization associated with Saudi Arabia's broader national AI ambitions. It is worth exploring for AI solution development and partnerships where local market knowledge and applied AI capabilities are priorities.

**Best for\:** Organizations exploring strategic AI partnerships and locally relevant AI solutions. Confirm the exact consulting scope and commercial engagement model directly. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/SCAI%20COMPANY/data=!4m7!3m6!1s0x3e2ee3bc6e06219d:0x3987dcea47cbe507!8m2!3d24.7598983!4d46.6033290!16s%2Fg%2F11tjd5ggfz!19sChIJnSEGbrzjLj4RB-XLR-rchzk?authuser=0&hl=en&rclk=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Вы не робот?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/n-5IqIgnn2smq93nZAjg7NzZd5epUfjoQsakX_276OLoVyk61k0-oQqWT2fJKaDWyjKHAGKxn79USV2hNLKIML0M2n-dUNl_sfCpYUuwvvyY2FSnmzuAC1ikxcqAGD7x9SkVoLUuU0Vfd_muO9kRr5TA8FBXkPf9At5ENfEIZTpTmiDcjpQahBbv41FPHypX?purpose=fullsize)

## 7\. Pulse Innovation Consulting (PIC)

Riyadh · [Official website](https://picsaudi.com/)

Emphasizes AI and data initiatives tied to measurable business value, leadership engagement, and internal capability development. Its AI practice describes work spanning use-case assessment through implementation.

**Best for\:** Leadership teams that want to prioritize AI investments, evaluate existing pilots, and demonstrate business returns. [picsaudi.com](https://picsaudi.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which firms would I approach first?

| Your main requirement | My first choices |
|--------|--------|
| Enterprise-wide AI strategy and implementation | Accenture, Capgemini |
| Specialist AI strategy plus hands-on engineering | Bilytica, Crux Technology |
| Focused pilot and phased rollout | NextGenSol |
| Saudi-focused AI partnerships | SCAI |
| AI investment prioritization and business value | Pulse Innovation Consulting |


These are fit-based recommendations, not independently verified rankings of delivery quality. The firms differ in scale, specialization, and engagement model.

## What to evaluate before selecting a firm

I recommend asking each shortlisted firm for the following\:

- **Strategy\:** An AI opportunity assessment, prioritized use cases, business cases, and a 12–24-month roadmap.
- **Implementation\:** Examples of AI systems deployed in production, not just proofs of concept.
- **Commercial value\:** Expected ROI, measurable KPIs, implementation costs, and ongoing operating costs.
- **Saudi compliance\:** How the proposed architecture addresses PDPL, relevant NDMO requirements, and sector-specific regulations where applicable.
- **Knowledge transfer\:** How your employees will operate, maintain, and improve the solutions after implementation.
- **Delivery team\:** The actual Saudi-based project leads and engineers who will deliver the engagement.

My recommendation is to invite three firms to a structured discovery process and ask each to propose an initial use case with measurable business value. Compare the proposed outcomes, delivery approach, timeline, and total cost before committing to a larger transformation.
